description: Test prompts for the customer support chatbot. 'category' is the ground-truth label the flow must predict.

test_cases.prompt: The checkout button doesn't work, it just spins forever when I click pay.
I got an error message when logging in: 'invalid session'.
My order #48291 is missing one of the items I paid for.
How long does standard shipping take?
Can I return an item after 30 days?
Which payment methods do you accept?
Where can I find my order history?
I want to speak to a human about a refund dispute.
